newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Superfos 1996 profit seen soaring.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Superfos 1996 profit seen soaring.

text.p: Five analysts polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Tuesday forecast an average 22 percent rise in 1996 pre-tax profits for Danish construction, chemicals and packaging group Superfos.
The analysts predicted an average 327 million crown profit before tax and extraordinary items for Superfos last year, compared to 269 million crowns in 1995.
The panel put 1996 net profit at an average 304 million crowns last year against 1995's full year 258 million crowns.
Last August, Superfos posted first-half 1996 net profits of 126 million crowns, up on 1995's interim 80 million crowns.
At that time Superfos forecast full year 1996 group pre-tax profits 20 percent up on the previous year, meaning that the Reuters poll points to a 1996 result exceeding the group's own expectations.
Superfos is due to announce its full year 1996 result on Thursday February 27.
